			'description': 'OCPSCH0104012MS:Ethernet12',

Config db schema generated by minigraph can’t pass yang validation, PORT table does not have 'lanes' field.
It seems that we need to update yang model or sonic-config-engine.

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run command 'sonic-cfggen -m tests/sample_graph.xml --print-data'.
2. Use sonic_yang to validate config db schema.

#### Describe the results you received:
Yang validation failed.

#### Describe the results you expected:
Yang validation should pass.

comments.author: qiluo-msft
comments.body:
The Step 1 needs `-p` parameter.
I checked below 2 command lines. All the ports have the lanes attribute.

```
$ sonic-cfggen -m tests/simple-sample-graph-case.xml --print-data -p tests/t0-sample-port-config.ini
$ sonic-cfggen -m tests/sample_graph.xml --print-data -p tests/t0-sample-port-config.ini
```

comments.author: ganglyu
comments.body:
@qiluo-msft 
Some test cases did not provide -p parameter:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-config-engine/tests/test_cfggen.py#L84-L87

And sample_graph.xml has an interface "Ethernet1", I have to add lanes for 'Ethernet1':
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/src/sonic-config-engine/tests/sample_graph.xml#L111-L118

Another solution is to use Ethernet4 to replace Ethernet1.
